figures.what: Bank of America auto loans, RC-C 6.c
Where KeyBank's direct auto book is filed, beyond RC-C 6.c
figures.note: KeyCorp's 10-K and 10-Q never state a direct auto balance (searched for automobile, auto, direct, indirect, marine, recreational): the nearest is 'consumer loans have collateral that includes residential real estate, automobiles, boats, and RVs'. The internal figure is not used here, by rule. What public data does settle: RC-C 6.c must hold all direct and indirect consumer loans to buy a car (62,212); consumer auto leases are 10.a (0); boats, RVs, motorcycles and cash loans against a car already owned are 6.d.

figures.ours_from: FDIC API: no field for RC-C 10.a
figures.source_from: filed on RC-C 10.a for every bank (read below)
figures.note: The FDIC API publishes total leases (LS) but no consumer-lease line, so the tool cannot carry 10.a.
